description: This Java class 'AccountNumberFormatDataValidator' is responsible for validating JSON input data related to account number formats in a Fineract-based application. It performs validation for create and update operations, ensuring parameters such as account type and prefix type are correct and conform to expected values.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating JSON data related to account number formatting. It validates create and update requests, ensuring correctness of parameters such as account type and prefix type, and provides helper methods to determine valid prefixes for different account types.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for creating a new account number format, checking for required fields and valid value ranges.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for updating an existing account number format, specifically checking provided parameters and their validity.

methods.name: determineValidAccountNumberPrefixes
methods.description: Returns the set of valid prefix values for a given account type.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if validation errors are detected during the validation process.
